description:
Other polygons for Fire, Algeria, 24 July 2023 (FR20230724DZA): 12 features merged from 12 source layers. Polygons layers that match none of the named groups. The source layer names below say what each holds. The `source_layer` and `source_file` columns name the layer and file each row came from.

From these HDX datasets:

- [Densité des foyers d'incendies dans les wilayas de Bouira, Tizi Ouzou et Bejaia le 24 juillet 2023](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/densite-des-foyers-d-incendies-dans-les-wilayas-de-bouira-tizi-ouzou-et-bejaia-le-24-juill)
- [Fire in Algeria - UNOSAT Live Web Map](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/fire-in-algeria-unosat-live-web-map)
- [Zones incendiées le 25 juillet 2023 dans la Wilaya de Bejaia, Algérie](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/zones-incendiees-le-25-juillet-2023-dans-la-wilaya-de-bejaia-algerie)
- [Zones incendiées le 25 juillet 2023 dans les communes de Melbou et Ziama Mansouria, Wilayas de Bejaia et Jijel, Algérie](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/zones-incendiees-le-25-juillet-2023-dans-les-communes-de-melbou-et-ziama-mansouria-wilayas)
- [Zones incendiées le 27 juillet 2023 dans les communes de Melbou et Ziama Mansouria, Wilayas de Bejaia et Jijel, Algérie](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/zones-incendiees-le-27-juillet-2023-dans-les-communes-de-melbou-et-ziama-mansouria-wilayas)

Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the columns and query recipes.

table:columns.name: Site_ID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = UN Building; 1 = Mosque; 2 = Hospital; 3 = Refugee / IDP Camp Building; 4 = Market; 5 = School / University; 6 = Square; 7 = Government Building; 9 = Border Crossing Point; 12 = Cemetary; 13 = Ruins; 16 = Stadium; 19 = Sewage Treatment Facility; 21 = Greenhouse; 22 = Bridge; 23 = Road; 24 = Tower; 25 = Prison; 26 = Building (General / Default); 27 = Field; 28 = Industrial Facility; 30 = Refugee / IDP Camp Site; 35 = Transport Vehicle; 40 = Military Base; 41 = Checkpoint; 42 = Military Facility; 45 = Suspected Mass Grave Site; 46 = Airport Facility; 47 = Church; 48 = Dam; 49 = Port. The decoded text is in `Site_ID_label`.

table:columns.name: Area_m2
table:columns.description: Area in square metres, as UNOSAT computed it.

table:columns.name: Area_ha
table:columns.description: Area in hectares, as UNOSAT computed it.

table:columns.name: SHAPE_Length
table:columns.description: Computed by ArcGIS in the units of the source layer's CRS (degrees for EPSG:4326), so it is not a metric measure.

table:columns.name: SHAPE_Area
table:columns.description: Computed by ArcGIS in the units of the source layer's CRS (degrees for EPSG:4326), so it is not a metric measure.

table:columns.name: EventCode
table:columns.description: UNOSAT event code (or a Copernicus EMSR id), as recorded on the feature. It does not always equal the code of the event subcatalog.

table:columns.name: Site_ID_label
table:columns.description: `Site_ID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, as UNOSAT published it (not repaired).

table:columns.name: source_layer
table:columns.description: Name of the layer in the source file that this row came from.

table:columns.name: source_file
table:columns.description: Name of the file downloaded from HDX that this row came from.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Bounding box of the geometry (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax), added for spatial filtering.
